card.name: Words leading into superlatives and comparisons
card.fires_on: Small words just before a superlative or comparison phrase in general web prose, such as "of" after "one", "most" after "the", or "like" after "just". Also seen on "tell" in a forum question.

modes.label: one of the...
modes.description: The word "of" after "one", leading into a group description such as "the easiest" or "the grand challenges".
modes.example: Understanding the functioning of brain network is one<< of>> the grand challenges of Science: many methods

modes.label: the most...
modes.description: The word "most" after "the", introducing a superlative adjective.
modes.example: It is the<< most>> useful gift for his family.

modes.label: comparison word
modes.description: A word like "like" or "considerable" that opens a comparison or quantity phrase.
modes.example: They became dense just<< like>> the fog.

card.plain: It marks the small word right before a phrase like "one of the most..." or "the most..." in ordinary web writing.
